name: Stack the Deck
body:
School divination; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 free action
Prop: cards
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: personal
Target: you
Duration: 1 round per level

DESCRIPTION

Each time you use your Card Trick (urban henge power), you can choose the effect rather than rolling for it.
